summary: Promoted the persistent-backend half of the measured failure into durable knowledge with exact sources (PersistentStorage::get_suffix delegating to get_entries, which returns Err(ErrHelper) for a below-compaction request, and the core's expect(READ_ERROR_MSG) at sequence_paxos/mod.rs:428 that raises the abort observed at witness index 8 of CheckRun 5ffdf2f10d3943d39f56133f08c42a6e), and retargeted the two open decision-formation questions to concrete retained cases: batched mixed proposals with element-wise decided-vector and index/content comparison, and leader-change adoption with prefix preservation before and after recovering the old leader.
